categories.name: Alarm_Set
categories.definition: Create a new alarm or set an existing alarm to go off at a specified time or interval.

categories.name: Alarm_Status
categories.definition: Check the status, time remaining, or schedule of existing alarms.

categories.name: Alarm_Cancel
categories.definition: Delete, turn off, or disable existing alarms.

categories.name: Alarm_Adjust
categories.definition: Modify settings of an existing alarm, such as snoozing or turning it on.

categories.name: Reminder_Set
categories.definition: Create a new reminder for a specific task or event at a future time.

categories.name: Reminder_Status
categories.definition: Query, show, or list existing reminders.

categories.name: Reminder_Cancel
categories.definition: Delete or remove existing reminders.

categories.name: Timer_Start
categories.definition: Start a new countdown timer for a specified duration.

categories.name: Timer_Status
categories.definition: Check the status, display, or remaining time of a running timer.

categories.name: Timer_Adjust
categories.definition: Modify a running timer by pausing, resuming, adding time, or stopping it.

categories.name: Call_Initiate

categories.name: Call_Manage
categories.definition: Manage an ongoing call by adding participants, switching modes, or hanging up.

categories.name: Message_Send

categories.name: Message_Query
categories.definition: Check for, read, or display received messages.

categories.name: Music_Play

categories.name: Music_Settings
categories.definition: Adjust music playback settings, skip tracks, or set default music providers.

categories.name: Weather_Query
categories.definition: Request weather conditions, forecasts, or temperatures for a specific location and time.

categories.name: News_Query
categories.definition: Request news headlines, stories, or specific information from news sources.

categories.name: Event_Query

categories.name: Event_RSVP

categories.name: Contact_Status_Query

categories.name: Communication_History

categories.name: Food_Info_Query

categories.name: Media_Info_Query
